test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly navigated to the Magento admin customer page (http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/customer/), suggesting it was performing customer search/filter operations. The test inputs are based on common customer data patterns for Magento systems: 'John' as a common first name, 'john@example.com' as a standard test email, 'General' as the default customer group, '12345' as a generic ZIP code, 'United States' as a common country, and 'California' as a typical state/province. These values represent realistic inputs that would work for testing customer search functionality in a Magento admin panel.
